description: This header file defines an interface for managing subscription objects in an event-driven system. It includes function declarations for subscribing, unsubscribing, retrieving subscription details, and managing collections of subscriptions.

methods.name: subscription_event
methods.description: Returns the event string associated with a subscription.

methods.name: subscription_function
methods.description: Retrieves the function callback associated with a subscription.

methods.name: subscription_context
methods.description: Provides the context pointer associated with a subscription.

methods.name: subscription_flags
methods.description: Returns the flags set for a subscription.

methods.name: subscriptions_get
methods.description: Fetches a specific subscription based on the event name from a collection of subscriptions.

methods.name: subscriptions_del
methods.description: Removes a subscription for a given event from the collection.

methods.name: subscriptions_add
methods.description: Adds a new subscription with specified callback, flags, and context to the collection.

methods.name: subscriptions_destroy
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a subscriptions collection.

methods.name: subscriptions_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new subscriptions collection.

ctags.name: subscription_function_t
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(const char * event,const char * payload,void * context)
